a.lede: Starting Nvidia's quarterly earnings call on Tuesday, new board chair Harvey Jones said that when former CEO Jensen Huang resigned, "the Nvidia board unanimously accepted his resignation and does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO." Jones added, "We will not be addressing or taking questions on today's call regarding the circumstances of Jensen's resignation […]
a.title: Nvidia says it does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO

b.lede: In his first statement since his resignation, former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang expressed openness to returning to his former role.
b.title: Jensen Huang says he would be ‘honored’ to return as Nvidia CEO
